name: outlook-list-messages
description:
List recent messages in one Outlook (Microsoft 365) mail folder through Microsoft Graph. Choose the folder (inbox, sentitems, drafts, archive, deleteditems, junkemail, or a folder id), the window (HOURS_BACK) and whether to keep only unread mail, and receive the newest first as structured metadata under the same names as 'Gmail: List Messages' (id, subject, from, to, date, snippet) plus is_read and web_link. `truncated` is true when the folder holds more messages in the window than were returned. One GET per run; read-only. Canonical building block for morning-brief / inbox-triage workflows on a Microsoft 365 mailbox.

Requires a vault:// reference to the Microsoft 365 OAuth access token in the AUTH_HEADER config key. The controller resolves + refreshes the token at dispatch time — you only pass the vault path. A mailbox that is not in Exchange Online fails with Graph's MailboxNotEnabledForRESTAPI error, not an empty list.

AUTH_HEADER.description: vault:// path to the OAuth access token wrapped in 'Bearer ' (e.g. 'Bearer vault://oauth/microsoft_365/{user_id}/{account_id}/access_token', where account_id is the account's Graph object id; list_connections gives the whole reference). The controller resolves the vault reference and refreshes the token if expired.

FOLDER.description: The mail folder: one of Graph's well-known names (inbox, sentitems, drafts, archive, deleteditems, junkemail; any case) or a folder id (letters, digits, '-', '_', '=', '+'; at most 256 characters). Anything else is refused.

HOURS_BACK.description: Only messages received in the last HOURS_BACK hours (1–720). Match it to the schedule: a run every 15 minutes needs 1, a morning brief 24.

UNREAD_ONLY.description: true: only messages not yet read.

MAX_RESULTS.description: Most messages returned (1–25), newest first. A value outside the range is refused rather than clamped.

setup_instructions.title: Register the app (operator, once)
setup_instructions.detail: Follow docs/microsoft-365-setup.md: an Entra app registration with the delegated Graph permissions User.Read, Mail.Read and offline_access (Calendars.Read for the calendar template), and MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_ID / MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_SECRET set on the controller.

setup_instructions.title: Connect the account
setup_instructions.detail: Connect Microsoft 365 from the integrations page. The controller stores the access_token + refresh_token at 'oauth/microsoft_365/{user_id}/{account_id}/access_token' and '.../refresh_token' and refreshes them before they expire. If your organisation blocks user consent to Mail.Read, an administrator grants it once (docs/microsoft-365-setup.md, Admin consent).

setup_instructions.title: Configure AUTH_HEADER
setup_instructions.detail: Set AUTH_HEADER to 'Bearer vault://oauth/microsoft_365/{your_user_id}/{account_id}/access_token' (list_connections gives the whole reference). If you hit 401s, call refresh_oauth_token(vault_path) to force a refresh and read the outcome; a refused refresh means the account must be reconnected.
